problem_text:
A logistics manager must select packages to ship on a cargo plane. The available packages are:
* Package A: size 18 cubic meters, revenue $19
* Package B: size 3 cubic meters, revenue $30
* Package C: size 14 cubic meters, revenue $142
* Package D: size 36 cubic meters, revenue $171
* Package E: size 24 cubic meters, revenue $300
* Package F: size 3 cubic meters, revenue $263
* Package G: size 46 cubic meters, revenue $244

The cargo plane has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic meters. Choose the set of packages that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this capacity limit. Each package must be shipped entirely or not at all.
